title: Deploy Party
description:
Foundry v14+. Any game system. Drag a folder of actors from the Actors directory onto the canvas to create a single party token. Right-click that token to open the normal Token HUD, then click Deploy to drop every actor in the folder onto the scene as its own token, arranged around the party marker.

Works great for parties, monster groups, or any pile of tokens you keep organized in a folder and want to place quickly.

Install: Setup → Add-on Modules → Install Module → https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X4mb/deploy-party-fvtt/main/module.json
